result.description: A fictional desktop music instrument built for experimental sound design, the Lattice Nova 27 combines a compact 27-key interface with dual wavetable oscillators, a resonant filter section, and onboard step sequencing. It is designed for live performers and studio composers who want evolving textures, hands-on control, and battery-free portability in a small-format synthesizer.
result.title: Lattice Nova 27 Analog Synthesizer
result.title_description: Compact analog-style synthesizer with wavetable synthesis and step sequencer
